name: Real Estate Site-Visit Follow-up – Voice Note to GHL, Similar Listings & Smart Follow-ups

parameters.content:
## 🏡 Site-Visit Voice Note → CRM, Listings & Follow-ups

### How it works
After a showing, the agent sends a Telegram voice note: who the buyer was, their phone or email, the property, and how it went. Whisper transcribes it and GPT pulls out budget, preferences, likes, concerns and an interest score (hot, warm or cold).

The buyer is created or updated in GoHighLevel with interest tags and a full visit note. Available listings from a Google Sheet are scored against the buyer's budget, area, bedrooms and type, and the top three are emailed to them. Follow-up tasks are added in GHL on a schedule that depends on interest: hot buyers get a call the next day, cold buyers a light touch in a week. The agent gets a short confirmation back in Telegram.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Telegram bot with BotFather and connect it, along with OpenAI, GoHighLevel (OAuth2), Google Sheets and Gmail.
2. Add a **Listings** tab with: listing_id, title, area, price, bedrooms, property_type, url, status.
3. In **Build Visit Record**, set your GHL location ID, an optional task owner, and the follow-up timing for each interest level.
4. Brief agents to say the buyer's name and phone or email in every note.
5. Activate the workflow.

## 🎙️ Voice Note Intake
Listens to the agent's Telegram chat. Voice notes are downloaded; anything else gets a quick reply asking for audio.

## 🧠 Transcribe & Extract
Whisper turns audio into text, GPT pulls out buyer details and an interest score, and the code node builds the CRM note and follow-up plan.

## 📇 GoHighLevel Update
Upserts the buyer by phone or email with interest tags, then attaches the visit note. If no contact details were heard, the agent is asked to resend.

## 🔎 Similar Listings
Scores available listings on area, budget, bedrooms and type, skipping the property already visited.

## ✉️ Buyer Email
Sends the top matches to the buyer, only when an email was captured and something actually matched.

## 📅 Follow-ups & Agent Confirmation
Creates one GHL task per follow-up step, timed by interest level, and messages the agent a summary of everything that was done.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use OAuth2 for GoHighLevel, Sheets and Gmail, an API key for OpenAI, and a bot token for Telegram. Keep location IDs and buyer data out of shared copies.

parameters.text: Send me a voice note after the visit – buyer's name, phone or email, the property, and how it went.

values.content:
You turn a real-estate agent's post-visit voice note into structured data. The agent just showed a property to a buyer and is talking quickly, so fix obvious transcription errors in names and numbers.

Judge interest from what the buyer said and did:
- hot (8–10): asked about negotiation, paperwork, loans or possession date; wants a second visit; bringing family to see it; buying within a month
- warm (5–7): liked it but is comparing options or has a solvable concern
- cold (1–4): major objections, over budget with no flexibility, or just browsing

Return only this JSON (use "" or 0 when something isn't mentioned, never guess contact details):
{
  "buyer_name": "",
  "buyer_phone": "digits with country code if said",
  "buyer_email": "",
  "property_visited": "address or name as the agent said it",
  "listing_id": "",
  "interest_score": 0,
  "interest_level": "hot | warm | cold",
  "budget_max": 0,
  "preferred_areas": [],
  "bedrooms": 0,
  "property_type": "apartment | villa | plot | house | commercial | other",
  "liked": [],
  "concerns": [],
  "buyer_next_step": "",
  "summary": "2–3 sentences in plain language"
}
